body.title: Homework
body.notes:
White labels rubber stamped with the Daft Punk logo.
Most copies are hand numbered.  Some include '/200' after the Hand-Numbering.

Limited to 200 copies.

The same master matrices were used for the first commercial pressing, but the matrix no. VISA 8148 was scratched out and replaced by 426101.

identifiers.value: MPO ViSA 8148 B1 THE EXCHANGE - NiLZ.
